title: Among all patients, find those who are either (a) female with uric acid abo
question: Among all patients, find those who are either (a) female with uric acid above 6.5 and abnormal IgM (≤40 or ≥400), or (b) male with total cholesterol within normal range (<250) and admitted as inpatients. For these patients, return their ID, sex, age, and the deviation of total protein from the upper normal limit (TP − 8.5). Only include patients whose total protein is recorded (not null).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    L."XCL_016" AS age,
    (L."XCL_020" - 8.5) AS tp_deviation
FROM
    Patient AS P
INNER JOIN
    Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN
    Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE
    L."XCL_020" IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        (
            P."XCL_059" = 'F'
            AND L."XCL_022" > 6.5
            AND (L."XCL_044" <= 40 OR L."XCL_044" >= 400)
        )
        OR
        (
            P."XCL_059" = 'M'
            AND L."XCL_026" < 250
            AND E."XCL_013" > 0
        )
    )
